commands: for f in skills/review/phases/*.md; do first=$(grep -m1 -n "prflow:review-ref" "$f" | head -1); echo "== $f"; sed -n '1p;$p' "$f" | grep -c "prflow:review-ref" ; done
for f in skills/review/phases/*.md; do echo "== $(basename $f)"; head -1 "$f" | grep -o "review-ref.*start" | head -c60; echo; tail -1 "$f" | grep -o "review-ref.*end" | head -c60; echo; done

cd skills/review/phases && for f in *.md; do echo "== $f"; head -1 "$f" | grep -oq "review-ref.*start" && echo "start-OK" || echo "START-MISSING"; tail -1 "$f" | grep -oq "review-ref.*end" && echo "end-OK" || echo "END-MISSING"; done

cat /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/lib/test/reference-size-exemptions.json 2>/dev/null; echo "===CHANGESET DIR==="; ls /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/.changeset/ 2>/dev/null; echo "===SAMPLE EXISTING CHANGESET (if any beyond new)==="; git -C /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow show HEAD:.changeset 2>/dev/null | head; echo "===consolidate script frontmatter keys==="; grep -nE "bump|type|schema|frontmatter|^\s*keys|require" /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow/scripts/consolidate-changesets.py 2>/dev/nul …[per-command-truncated]

gh pr view 1760 --json headRefOid --jq .headRefOid
echo "---anchor pin (#275 P4) byte-identity check: review SKILL.md vs docs SKILL.md preamble---"
diff <(grep -n 'CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR:-<absolute skill base directory' skills/review/SKILL.md | head -1) /dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "anchor present in review root: $(grep -c 'Portable helper anchor' skills/review/SKILL.md)"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
